name: Reactor
desc: The fission plant at the core. Everything runs off its cell lines, and the engineers sleep next to it.
notes: Feeds power for the whole station. Breakdown events here move need_power hardest.

name: Solar vanes
desc: Mirror sails on the ring, fed by real sunlight. Pretty, fragile, owned by the rich.
notes: Small but steady; first to be blamed in a dust storm.

name: Scrubber bank
desc: Rows of cartridge scrubbers along the spine. They take the breath out of the air and give it back.
notes: The spine lives on this. When a bank clogs, filters and canisters are bought in a hurry.

name: Algae lungs
desc: Green tanks on the mid decks that breathe in carbon and breathe out air, and sometimes feed a few.
notes: Sensitive to heat; a bloom or a die-off both hurt.

name: Water reclaim
desc: The loop of recovery tanks under the spine: every drop used again until it will not clean.
notes: Sludge leaves here for the digester and the vent.

name: Ice haul
desc: Tugs bring comet ice to the dock and crane crews cut it for the melters.
notes: Source of ice blocks (haul). A strike or a lost tug sends water prices up.

name: Ring farms
desc: Real soil under real light, behind glass. Feeds the ring and sells the spare for gold.
notes: Luxury food and drink originate here; blight events hit the ring first.

name: Vat halls
desc: Ranks of culture vats in the works. They turn biomass into bread, protein and the grey paste everyone eats.
notes: Eats biomass paste; contamination here is the food crisis.

name: Foundry
desc: Smelters and rolling mills in the works. Makes bars and sheet for the whole station.
notes: Eats ore and scrap; a stoppage starves every fabricator.

name: Ore haul
desc: Cargo tugs and crane crews bringing ore to the dock. The only source of fresh metal.
notes: Source of ore (haul). A convoy delay or blockade starves the foundry.

name: Clinic
desc: Three rooms on the mid decks and a pharmacy that is always one order behind.
notes: Single point of failure for medicine; epidemics bite it directly.

name: Company store
desc: Hub shelves with the company mark: licensed, paid in company scrip, never out of stock for long.
notes: Sets comfort prices on the hub and the mid decks; policy events change what it stocks.
